# ==========================================
# Custom function to load github scripts 
get_github_files <-function(user, repo, path, load_fn = source, file_ext="r", file_pf=NULL) {
  api <- sprintf("https://api.github.com/repos/%s/%s/contents/%s", user, repo, path)
  files <- grep(paste0("\\.",file_ext,"$"), jsonlite::fromJSON(api)$name, value = T, ignore.case = T)
  if(!is.null(file_pf)) { 
    files <- grep(file_pf, files, value=T) 
  } ; print(sprintf("LOADING | %s/%s/%s ... FILES | %s", user, repo, path, paste0(files, collapse=", ")))
  
  URLs <- lapply(files, function(f) sprintf("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/%s/%s/main/%s/%s", user, repo, path, f))
  if(file_ext != "r") {
    gh_files.l <- invisible(lapply(URLs, load_fn)) ; 
    names(gh_files.l) <- gsub(paste0("[.]", file_ext), "", files) 
    return(gh_files.l) 
  } else { invisible(lapply(URLs, load_fn)) }
}

## Distributions of fasting labs in NHANES

```{r}
recode_labs <- c("fg" = "FG, mg/dL", "fi" = "FI, uU/mL", "ogtt_2hg_cleaned"="2hrG, mg/dL", 
                 "ftg" = "TG, mg/dL", "tc" = "TC, mg/dL", "hdl" = "HDL, mg/dL", 
                 "ldl_friedewald"="LDL, mg/dL")

## Fasting glycemic measures
nhanes_ndi %>% 
  select(SEQN, fastinglabs) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-SEQN, names_to = "FastingLabs") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>% 
  mutate_at("FastingLabs", ~factor(., levels = names(recode_labs))) %>%
  filter(FastingLabs %in% c("fg","fi", "ogtt_2hg_cleaned")) %>% 
  mutate(FastingLabs = recode(FastingLabs, !!!recode_labs)) %>%
  ## Filter to subset of indices
  ggplot(aes(x=value)) + 
  facet_wrap(~FastingLabs, scale = "free") + 
  geom_histogram() + 
  ylab("Distribution, n") + xlab("Fasting blood levels") +
  ggplot_theme_basic

## Fasting lipids 
nhanes_ndi %>% 
  select(SEQN, fastinglabs) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-SEQN, names_to = "FastingLabs") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>% 
  mutate_at("FastingLabs", ~factor(., levels = names(recode_labs))) %>%
  filter(!FastingLabs %in% c("fg","fi", "ogtt_2hg_cleaned")) %>% 
  mutate(FastingLabs = recode(FastingLabs, !!!recode_labs)) %>%
  ## Filter to subset of indices
  ggplot(aes(x=value)) + 
  facet_wrap(~FastingLabs, scale = "free") + 
  geom_histogram() + 
  ylab("Distribution, n") + xlab("Fasting blood levels") +
  ggplot_theme_basic
  
```

#### Heat map of Spearman correlations among fasting labs in NHANES

```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap) ; library(circlize)

cormat_fastlabs <- readRDS("../data/output/insind/tab_descr_corr_fastinglabs.rds")
recode_labs_format <- names(recode_labs) ; names(recode_labs_format) <- recode_labs

mat <- cormat_fastlabs$corr %>%
  select(-level) %>% 
  mutate_at("variable", ~recode(., !!!recode_labs)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("variable") %>% 
  rename(recode_labs_format) %>%
  as.matrix()

## Heatmap of Spearman correlations among fasting labs 
Heatmap(mat, rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1),
  row_names_side = "left", column_title_side = "bottom",
  name = "Spearman corr\n for fasting labs", 
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize=9), column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize=9),
  column_names_rot = 45,
  col=colorRamp2(c(-1,0,1), c(palettes$NatExt$Blues[3], "#FFFFFF", palettes$NatExt$Reds[3]))
  )

```

## Preliminary regression results

```{r}

## List of models
models.l <- list(
  base=c("age", "gender", "racethn_combn"),
  bmi=c("age", "gender", "racethn_combn", "bmi"))

recode_cvoutcomes <- c("CVD", "ASCVD", "CHF", "HTN", "Diabetes")
names(recode_cvoutcomes) <- outcomes$cvrelated

recode_mortoutcomes <- c("Any Death", "CVD Death","HD Death", "CBVD Death", "Diabetes Death")
names(recode_mortoutcomes) <- outcomes$mortality

# Load regression summary tables
tab_glms_cvoutcomes <- fread("../data/output/insind/tab_glms_fastlabs_cvoutcomes_basebmi.csv")
tab_coxph_mortality <- fread("../data/output/insind/tab_coxph_fastlabs_mortality_basebmi.csv")
```

#### CV-related outcomes 
```{r}
# Print abbreviated table output
tab_glms_cvoutcomes <- tab_glms_cvoutcomes %>% 
  mutate_at(c("beta", "low95CI", "up95CI"), ~round(., d=3)) %>%
  mutate(P.value = ifelse(pval<0.01, format(pval, scientific=T, digits=2), round(pval, d=2))) %>%
  mutate("Beta.95CI" = sprintf("%s (%s, %s)", beta, low95CI, up95CI)) %>%
  mutate_at("exposure", ~recode(., !!!recode_labs)) %>%
  select(
    cycle_yrs, Covars=model_covars, Exposure=exposure, 
    Outcome=outcome, Beta.95CI, P.value, N_Raw = n_exp_raw, N_Wt=n_exp_weighted
    ) 

# Base model --------------
tab_glms_cvoutcomes %>% filter(!grepl("bmi", Covars)) %>% 
  select(-Covars) %>% 
  kable(caption = "Associations of fasting labs with prevalent CV-related outcomes, adjusting for Age/Sex/RaceEthn")

# BMI model --------------
tab_glms_cvoutcomes %>% filter(grepl("bmi", Covars)) %>% 
  select(-Covars) %>% 
  kable(caption = "Associations of fasting labs with prevalent CV-related outcomes, adjusting for Age/Sex/RaceEthn+BMI")

```

##### Mortality outcomes
```{r}
tab_coxph_mortality <- tab_coxph_mortality %>% 
  mutate_at(c("HR", "low95CI_HR", "up95CI_HR"), ~round(., d=3)) %>%
  mutate(P.value = ifelse(pval<0.01, format(pval, scientific=T, digits=2), round(pval, d=2))) %>%
  mutate("HR.95CI" = sprintf("%s (%s, %s)", HR, low95CI_HR, up95CI_HR)) %>%
  mutate_at("exposure", ~recode(., !!!recode_labs)) %>%
  mutate_at("event_var", ~recode(., !!!recode_mortoutcomes)) %>%
  arrange(event_var) %>% 
  select(
    cycle_yrs, N.years=n_yrs, Covars=model_covars, Exposure=exposure, 
    Outcome=event_var, N_Events_Raw=n_event_raw, N_Events_Wt=n_event_weighted,
    PersonYrs.Raw=n_person_time_raw, PersonYrs.Wt=n_person_time_weighted,
    HR.95CI, P.value, Flag=flag_n_total)

# Base model --------------
tab_coxph_mortality %>% filter(!grepl("bmi", Covars)) %>% 
  select(-Covars) %>% 
  kable(caption = "Associations of fasting labs with mortality outcomes, adjusting for Age/Sex/RaceEthn")

# BMI model --------------
tab_coxph_mortality %>% filter(grepl("bmi", Covars)) %>% 
  select(-Covars) %>% 
  kable(caption = "Associations of fasting labs with mortality outcomes, adjusting for Age/Sex/RaceEthn+BMI")

```
